verdict.rationale: Requesty's analytics dashboard tracks costs, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency across all models/providers in real-time, and trace_id/user_id tagging plus BYOK support per-key tracking, which covers most of the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-team breakdowns/team-level grouping, per-user cost attribution dashboards, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the analytics dashboard's granularity beyond vendor docs.
